title_fb: GTA 6 is out tomorrow. Its famous writer isn't in it
hook: Tomorrow, GTA six comes out. Its famous writer did not write it.
open_loop: Line 1 withholds who the writer is; the restaurant parable teases the problem; the name is revealed in line 4; the question 'still a GTA game?' pays off in the last line.
payoff: Plain facts: Dan Houser wrote Rockstar's famous stories, left in March 2020 after a long break, and said he wrote none of GTA 6. Then the viewer decides.

lines.text: Tomorrow, GTA 6 comes out. Its famous writer did not write it.
lines.say: Tomorrow, GTA six comes out. Its famous writer did not write it.
lines.visual: SCENE 1 (frame 0): Benny, shocked, holds a phone; plain-text sign 'GTA 6' behind him; a dark silhouette box with '?' beside it. Headline 'WHO WROTE IT?' already on screen. Snap-zoom on 'six'. SCENE 2 (on 'Its'): the '?' silhouette pulses, stamp 'NOT HIM' slams on 'not' (thud), Benny's jaw drops.

lines.text: Imagine your favorite restaurant. The famous chef quits, but the sign stays.
lines.visual: SCENE 3 (on 'Imagine'): thought bubble 'YOUR FAVORITE' with a plain sign 'RESTAURANT' (no brand); Benny, happy, rubs his belly, drooling; points at the viewer on 'your'. SCENE 4 (on 'The'): a hooded stranger waves bye and drifts out (drift -500); stamp 'QUIT' on 'quits'; GAG: the sign wobbles but Benny still smiles on 'sign stays'.

lines.text: Benny bites in. It tastes different.
lines.visual: SCENE 5 (on 'Benny'): Benny bites a plain generic plate icon (no logo), eyes squeezed shut. On 'different': buzz, face flips to shocked then slump, tongue out; bubble 'HUH?'.

lines.text: The chef is Dan Houser. He wrote Rockstar's famous stories.
lines.visual: SCENE 6 (on 'Dan'): headline 'DAN HOUSER' slams (ding) with sub 'WRITER'; the silhouette from scene 1 fills in as the hooded stranger, Benny points at him, wide-eyed. SCENE 7 (on 'He wrote'): Benny holds a thick stack with a plain text badge 'STORIES' (no art); stranger smug.

lines.text: He left in March 2020, after a long break.
lines.say: He left in March twenty twenty, after a long break.
lines.visual: SCENE 8 (on 'He'): badge 'MARCH 2020' drops (clink); the stranger walks off-screen (drift) on 'long break'; Benny waves a sad goodbye, then worry pose.

lines.text: Last year, he said he wrote none of GTA 6.
lines.say: Last year, he said he wrote none of GTA six.
lines.visual: SCENE 9 (on 'Last'): badge 'LAST YEAR' pops; speech bubble from the stranger on 'he said': 'I WROTE NONE'. SCENE 10 (on 'GTA'): the plain-text 'GTA 6' sign flashes, flash cut, snap-zoom, Benny shock pose with both hands on head; drum sfx.

lines.text: Still a GTA game? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: SCENE 11 (on 'Still'): Benny, thinking, hand on chin, looks at the sign 'GTA 6'. Rows: 'A: STILL GTA' on 'Still', 'B: NOT GTA' on 'Comment'; Benny points at viewer on 'Comment'. Rows only, no footer.
lines.on_screen: A: STILL GTA / B: NOT GTA

facts_used.claim: GTA 6 releases November 19, 2026 (we say 'tomorrow' because the video publishes Nov 18 at 7 PM ET).
Dan Houser, Rockstar co-founder and VP of Creative, wrote the stories of GTA and Red Dead. Take-Two said (Feb 2020) he would leave, last day March 11, 2020, after an extended break.
Houser told IGN (reported Sept 30, 2025) GTA 6 is 'not going to be a story that I wrote or a character set that I developed'.

math_check: Spoken words: L1 12, L2 12, L3 6, L4 10, L5 9, L6 10, L7 8 = 67. Longest sentence 12 words. 67 / 2.3 = 29.1 s + pauses = about 31 s. March 2020 is identical in voice (twenty twenty), caption and badge. 'Last year' = Sept 2025 interview, correct from Nov 2026.

upload.description:
Can it still be a GTA game if its famous writer wrote none of it?
A or B: still a GTA game, or not? Comment below.
Dan Houser wrote Rockstar's famous stories. He left in March 2020, and last year he said GTA 6 is not a story he wrote.
Sources: Dan Houser to IGN (via TechRadar, Sept 2025); Take-Two filing (via Game Informer, 2020). Unofficial fan commentary, not affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two.
